activity.notes: Petar II ruled the theocratic Prince-Bishopric of Montenegro as prince-bishop from 1830 to 1851. ATLAS does not retroject the later secular Principality of Montenegro onto his reign.

sources.title: Petar II Petrović Njegoš — National Library of Montenegro digital collection
sources.citation_text: The Montenegrin national digital collection identifies Petar II Petrović-Njegoš as Montenegro's bishop and ruler from 1830 until 1851.
